summary: Projectile turrets launch tracked server-authoritative entities whose travel, collision, damage and area effects match the intended turret family.

authoritative_state: TurretHeadBlockEntity alone decides whether a shot may be created after target, energy and ammunition validation.
TurretProjectileEntity owns projectile kind, damage, damage multiplier, source base position, target identity and lifetime.
Collision, homing, fire, explosions, damage and kill attribution are resolved only by the logical server.

fields: projectile_kind:string=disposable constrained to the declared ProjectileKind ids
source_base_pos:optional BlockPos used only for server-side access and kill attribution
target_uuid:optional UUID used only by homing projectiles
age is bounded by a hard maximum lifetime and projectiles discard safely after reload

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: Projectile simulation and damage remain fully functional without loading a renderer; vanilla entity tracking carries position and item appearance.

manual: Existing GPL-compatible OMT ammunition textures rendered through the vanilla thrown-item renderer.

budgets.scope: One hundred continuously active turrets after all earlier shots have exceeded their lifetime
budgets.measurement: Run the representative load for 200 ticks and count live OMT projectile entities.

hot_paths: TurretProjectileEntity tick collision and rocket homing
performance.measurement_environment: Java 21, fixed GameTest world, 100 firing turret heads and bounded projectile lifetime.

mods.fallback: Projectile combat is unavailable outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

steps: Place and power machine-gun, incendiary, grenade, rocket and plasma turrets with valid ammunition where required.
Observe projectile travel, collision, area effects, rocket homing and client rendering from a second connected client.
Save and reload while projectiles are in flight, then repeat near protected players and the owning base.
manual_checks.expected: Each projectile has its intended appearance and effect, never damages a forbidden target, and cannot duplicate damage or resources.

non_goals: Ray-traced laser, rail-gun, relativistic and teleporter implementations.
Final turret BlockEntityRenderer models and barrel animations.
Config-screen exposure of every projectile tuning value.
